title: Prospective Manipulable-Architecture Coordinate Experiment, Age-on-Hit Semantic Intervention, Topology-Matched Indexing Counterfactual, Held-Out Law-Field Prediction & Descriptor-to-Causal-Morphism Identification

interpretation.manipulability: probe_refreshes_age_on_hit was successfully materialized bidirectionally with native-equivalence gates on Stockfish 19, Berserk, and Ethereal
interpretation.causal_effect: nonzero history-conditioned law-fingerprint effects were observed in Stockfish 19 and Berserk under the frozen 80k history instrument
interpretation.transport: the low-capacity donor-consensus descriptor-to-law morphism did not transport universally to held-out Ethereal
interpretation.ethereal: Ethereal showed 0/16 law-fingerprint transitions under the frozen readout; this does not establish zero lower-level TT effect beyond P27's observation map
interpretation.indexing: no indexing-family causal effect was estimated because the predeclared topology-isomorphism witness was unavailable

portability_incident.cause: Ethereal src/makefile basic target uses CFLAGS with -march=native, making the frozen binary non-portable across heterogeneous GitHub hosted runner CPUs
portability_incident.symptom: some held-out jobs terminated before UCI handshake with UCI_OK failure
portability_incident.repair: GitHub failed-jobs-only exact reruns of the same frozen binary artifacts and same precommit/prediction contract until execution occurred on compatible runners
portability_incident.note: No worlds, histories, binaries, intervention semantics, state mappings, prediction rules, support rules, or adjudication thresholds were changed after prediction seal.

claim_ceiling: Authority is limited to the P26-inherited frozen support, mapped K8 anchor state, deterministic persistent-TT history, and 80k measurement budget.
The estimated age-coordinate effect is a history-conditioned total effect that may include mediated TT survival/replacement consequences, not an instantaneous direct effect.
The held-out failure rejects a universal low-capacity descriptor-to-law morphism for the tested architectures; it does not establish that no richer conditional morphism exists.
Ethereal's 0/16 fingerprint transition is a null result at the frozen P27 observation map, not proof of zero internal causal effect.
No 40k/160k/300k budget transport claim is authorized.
Indexing-family causality remains on hold without a topology-isomorphism witness.
